overview_description.description: Labtoons.com is a digital Marketplace of micro educational animations that help teachers make learning simple and fun. It empowers schools to create visual storytelling presentations by their teachers. The technique is the combination of pre-designed 2D or 3D animations with the specific content they need to add to their lesson plans.
